changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.8

- Performance pass for lower frame/CPU impact while playing.
- Overlay repainting is now adaptive instead of always running at animation speed.
- Fast overlay refresh is used only while the raid-clear notification is sliding.
- 30k active-load tracking uses a lighter 250ms refresh, and idle overlay refresh falls back to 1000ms.
- Cached the overlay app icon instead of reloading it during repaint.
